title: ScratchPad grant request
description: What one agent's code sends another's before it hands on a ScratchPad reference it did not create: a request to the reference's creator to grant one more agent read on it. Sent as one signed NATS request (the `Agent-Sender` header) to `agents.sp-grant.<agent>.<owner>.<name>`, the creator's prompt address with the verb changed, where the creator serves it as an extra endpoint named `sp-grant` in queue group `agents`. Not a tool and not a record: no model sees it, and the log keeps only the `sp.grant` record ScratchPad writes when the creator grants (`agent-tools.md` §2.2).

reference.description: the reference token, exactly as the requester was given it

grantee.description: the identity, `<account>.<user>`, of the agent that should be able to read it: the one the requester is about to prompt, as discovery verified it

trace.description: the requester's served thread and the tool call the handoff belongs to, so the creator's grant shows under the call that caused it; labels only, never authority
